# Logging, Monitoring and Alerting (LOG)

## SCS-LOG-02 Never log secrets or personal data, and neutralize log injection

Level: MUST

Applies to: All (Flutter and Backend)

Policy: Logs, debug output, crash reports and analytics MUST NOT contain passwords, tokens, session IDs, API keys, connection strings, full payment card numbers or personal data beyond what an investigation needs. Request bodies containing such data MUST NOT be logged. Logs MUST NOT be written to publicly accessible locations. User-supplied values in logs MUST be neutralized against log injection.

Implementation (Flutter):

- print and debugPrint still print in release builds. Silence them in release (for example debugPrint = (m, {wrapWidth}) {} when kReleaseMode), and enable the avoid_print lint.
- Never use dio LogInterceptor with headers or bodies in release builds.
- Scrub tokens and personal data from crash and analytics reports (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry) before sending.

Verification: Search a day of staging logs for "password", "Bearer ", "token", card number patterns and national ID patterns.
